class.name: LuisaCompute
class.brief_description: Luisa Compute companion running on the engine's Vulkan device.
class.description: LuisaCompute imports Godot's Vulkan [code]VkInstance[/code]/[code]VkDevice[/code]/queues into a compute-only Luisa Compute [Device] and exposes zero-copy bidirectional buffer/texture interop. The Luisa device is created lazily by calling [method ensure_device] after [method RenderingDevice.make_current] (usually during renderer setup), and must be destroyed with [method shutdown] before the Godot Vulkan context is torn down. Only one Luisa Vulkan [Device] may be alive in a process at a time (Volk process-global dispatch tables). The companion is enabled by building the engine with [code]luisa_compute=yes[/code]; both the SCons and XMake builds use the same build mode (debug/release) so the produced libraries are ABI- and CRT-compatible with the engine.

method.name: ensure_device
method.description: Lazily creates the Luisa [Device] on top of Godot's Vulkan handles. Safe to call multiple times; returns [code]true[/code] once the device exists. Call after [method RenderingDevice.make_current].

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Destroys the Luisa [Device] and every borrowed command buffer before Godot tears down the Vulkan context (every imported handle is owned by Godot). Called automatically at server-level teardown.
